notes: «- يعني ابن يونس -» is an editor gloss and is left out.
«بإسناد أبي مصعب ومعناه» points to another isnad written elsewhere (Abu Musab's): a back reference, not a name.
This report is a dispute about the transmission: «فلقيت سهيلا فسألته ... فقال ما أعرفه». Whether Suhayl is the last link (rule 6) is not settled, so he is left out and needs_ruling is set.
